prompt:
A foreign friend of yours has recently graduated from college and intends to find a job in China. Write him/her an email to make some suggestions.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your name in the email; use “Li Ming” instead. (10 points)
body: Congratulations on your graduation! I’m delighted to hear that you plan to work in China, and here are a few suggestions.

First, it would be wise to improve your Chinese, as even basic language skills will make both job hunting and daily life much easier. Second, think carefully about which city suits you best. Big cities like Shanghai and Shenzhen offer more opportunities, but living costs there are much higher. Third, job websites and career fairs for foreigners are good places to start, and check the work visa requirements in advance.
I hope you find an ideal job soon. If you need any help, just let me know.

prompt:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the picture below. In your essay, you should
1) describe the picture briefly,
2) interpret the implied meaning, and
3) give your comments.
Write your answer on the ANSWER SHEET. (20 points)

【图画】一个穿着京剧戏服的小男孩对爸爸说：“爸爸，很多同学觉得学唱戏不好玩。”爸爸说：“你自己不是喜欢吗？那就足够了。”
body: In the picture, a little boy dressed in a Peking Opera costume says to his father, “Dad, many of my classmates think learning Peking Opera is no fun.” His father smiles and replies, “Don’t you like it yourself? That’s enough.”

The picture conveys a simple yet profound message: we should follow our own interests rather than other people’s opinions. Many young people give up their hobbies simply because others consider them dull or old-fashioned. However, it is genuine passion that keeps us going when we meet difficulties and eventually leads us to success. Moreover, the boy’s love for Peking Opera reminds us that traditional art needs young successors, and only those who truly love it can carry it forward.

In my view, the father sets a good example for all parents. Rather than pushing children to follow the crowd, parents should respect and support their genuine interests. As for young people, we should have the courage to stick to what we love, no matter what others say. After all, a life driven by passion is far more rewarding than one shaped by other people’s expectations.

prompt:
Suppose you are organizing an online meeting. Write an email to Jack, an international student, to
1) invite him to participate, and
2) tell him about the details.
You should write about 100 words on the ANSWER SHEET.
Do not use your own name. Use “Li Ming” instead. (10 points)
body: I’m writing to invite you to an online meeting on traditional Chinese festivals, which I am organizing for international students.

The meeting will be held on Tencent Meeting from 7 to 9 p.m. next Friday. First, two professors from the History Department will give short talks on the origins and customs of major festivals. After that, everyone will be welcome to share the festivals of their own countries. Since you are so interested in Chinese culture, I’m sure you will enjoy it.
I will send you the meeting ID and password the day before. Please let me know by Wednesday whether you can attend.

prompt:
Write an essay based on the chart below. In your writing, you should
1) interpret the chart, and
2) give your comments.
You should write about 150 words on the ANSWER SHEET. (15 points)

【图表】某市居民体育锻炼方式调查（柱状图）：独自锻炼 54.30%，和朋友一起 47.70%，和家人一起 23.90%，团体活动 15.80%
body: The bar chart illustrates how residents of a city take exercise. As can be seen, exercising alone is the most popular way, chosen by 54.3% of the respondents, closely followed by exercising with friends at 47.7%. By contrast, only 23.9% exercise with their family members, and group activities rank last at a mere 15.8%.

Several factors may account for this. For one thing, exercising alone is flexible: people can run or work out whenever they are free, without having to fit in with anyone else’s schedule. For another, friends usually share similar interests and habits, which makes it easy for them to exercise together. Exercising with family or in groups, however, is less common, probably because of busy schedules and a lack of organized activities in communities.

In my opinion, every way of exercising has its own advantages. Whatever form people choose, what matters most is to make exercise a regular habit. Meanwhile, communities could organize more group activities to make exercise more enjoyable and sociable.
